purpose: Official-source registry for Pakistani undergraduate admissions. Source status is not a claim that every program, campus, or intake rule has been reviewed.

verification_policy.verified: A concrete criterion or date was checked on the official source and the record states its exact scope and cycle.
verification_policy.partially_verified: Official source and some current content were checked, but program/campus/cycle details remain incomplete.
verification_policy.unverified: Source discovery only; do not use it to evaluate eligibility.
verification_policy.stale: The cited intake or schedule has passed or the criterion cannot safely be carried forward.
verification_policy.conflicting: Official sources disagree; deterministic evaluation must remain indeterminate.

sources.title: FAST-NUCES Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria
sources.scope: 2026 undergraduate degree groups, academic minimums, subjects, and test/merit weighting; a rule may be used only when its program is mapped to the exact category described by this page.
sources.notes: The official page was updated 10-Aug-2026. Computing programs list SSC 60%, HSSC 50%, and Mathematics; engineering lists 60% in both SSC and HSSC. It does not supply a guaranteed closing merit cutoff.

sources.title: NUST Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria
sources.scope: Published general minimum marks and named qualification/subject pathways for listed undergraduate programmes, including BS Artificial Intelligence and computing programmes.
sources.notes: Minimum 60% in each of SSC and HSSC/equivalent; foreign qualifications require IBCC equivalence. The page notes remedial mathematics conditions for some pre-medical computing applicants.

sources.title: NUST Merit Generation Criteria (NET basis)
sources.scope: General NET-based undergraduate merit weights only: NET 75%, SSC/equivalent 10%, HSSC/equivalent 15%. This exact scope does not establish every program/route exception or admission probability.
sources.notes: The official page explicitly lists 75% NET, 10% SSC/O-Level/equivalent, and 15% HSSC/A-Level/equivalent for general NET-based merit; program-wise test paper and route exceptions are listed separately. The weights are not an estimate of admission probability.

sources.title: COMSATS University Islamabad Admissions Portal
sources.notes: Program, campus, test, and current-cycle rules must be extracted and reviewed before use in deterministic evaluation.

sources.title: GIKI Undergraduate Eligibility and Assessment Criteria
sources.scope: Published baseline for engineering and computing subjects/marks; no intake cycle is stated in the visible source.
sources.notes: The page lists 60% overall and subject minimums for Mathematics and Physics for relevant pathways. Do not carry this into a named intake as verified until that intake's prospectus confirms it.

sources.title: LUMS Undergraduate Programmes
sources.scope: Programme/school listings for Fall 2027; this page alone does not establish every school's academic and test requirements.
sources.notes: Use programme-specific school requirements and official dates before calculating eligibility. Do not treat LUMS as one uniform threshold.

sources.title: LUMS Admissions Calendar
sources.scope: Published Fall 2027 undergraduate calendar dates as displayed on the official page.
sources.notes: The page lists the undergraduate online application deadline as 20-Jan-2027, document/payment deadline 21-Jan-2027, SAT deadline 06-Mar-2027, LCAT 21-Mar-2027, and ACT deadline 10-Apr-2027. Recheck the official calendar for later changes.

sources.title: UET Lahore Undergraduate Admissions FAQ
sources.scope: Closed Fall 2026 window and its published programme-category requirements only.
sources.notes: The FAQ lists 08-Jun-2026 to 15-Jul-2026 as the application window; it is past as of this registry date. Do not infer Fall 2027 dates or criteria from it.

sources.title: MUET Directorate of Admissions Policy
sources.scope: Published pre-admission test and CPN formula; current program/year eligibility still needs an intake prospectus.
sources.notes: The page says less than 40% on the pre-admission test is disqualifying and shows CPN weighting of SSC 10%, HSC-I 30%, and test 60%. It is not enough by itself to determine a student's full programme eligibility.

sources.title: NED Undergraduate Admissions Schedule 2026
sources.notes: The schedule is from the 2026 intake. Current and future eligibility/merit rules must be checked against the active prospectus.

sources.title: University of Karachi Prospectus 2026
sources.notes: Do not derive a single university-wide eligibility threshold from this prospectus; individual department rules must be extracted and checked.

sources.title: University of the Punjab Admission Notice 2026-2027
sources.scope: 2026-2027 notice and admission-process facts; program and phase-specific merit rules must be checked in each current notice.
sources.notes: The initial online application window July-August 2026 is past; the university may publish additional vacant-seat/second-phase notices. Do not imply the initial window remains open.

sources.title: IBA Karachi Offered Programmes and Admission Requirements
sources.scope: Displayed academic entry requirements for BBA and BS programmes on the current official page; page does not identify a cycle in the extracted requirements.
sources.notes: The page displays HSSC minimum 65% for BBA and HSSC 60% in Pre-Engineering/General Science (Computer Science) for BS Computer Science. A dated intake notice must confirm application dates and any changes.

sources.title: University of the Punjab Undergraduate Admissions — Phase 2 Vacant Seats
sources.scope: Phase 2 vacant-seat application window only; this is a dated notice, not a general program eligibility rule.
sources.notes: The official notice lists applications from 08-Sep-2026 to 28-Sep-2026. That window has passed as of 22-Oct-2026; do not describe this phase as open or infer future dates from it.
